note: Definition of the release gate (contract section 22, owner decisions 7 and 8 of CONTRACT_AUDIT_STAGE1). 'policy' is blocking (never waivable) or waivable (only by a signed owner waiver). Nothing here is a verdict: the verdict is computed from test results and files at gate time.
